results.name: engine_process_killed
results.observed: launcher restarted the engine (restarts=1, last_error 'engine exited with code -9'); credentials reloaded from storage/passwords (engine.json secrets=loaded); six event sourcetypes generated and verified afterwards (events_after_engine_kill.json)

results.name: launcher_killed
results.observed: engine exited by itself within 8 s: 0 pulseforge processes (no orphan); gateway /engine reported stopped with an instruction; POST /engine/restart (netspout_admin) toggled the launcher input and the engine returned healthy within 30 s

results.name: splunk_restart
results.observed: engine back to healthy with restarts=0 and secrets=loaded; events and IOS XR metrics generated and verified afterwards (events_after_splunk_restart.json)

results.name: splunk_stop
results.observed: `splunk stop`: 0 launcher/engine processes afterwards, socket removed (checked on the earlier build of the same launcher code on a separate disposable Splunk 10.2.7)
results.note: not repeated on the final fresh container

results.name: upgrade_in_place
results.observed: same package re-installed with update=true then Splunk restart: local/macros.conf customer stanza and local/passwords.conf kept, /api/setup identical (configured, SPLUNK_ENTERPRISE, both indexes, both credentials configured), engine healthy, six event sourcetypes verified afterwards (events_after_upgrade.json)
results.limit: upgrade from 2.0.1 (two-component) to this package was not tested: the package id is the same, and the Engine URL setting from 2.0.1 is ignored by this build

results.name: uninstall
results.observed: DELETE /services/apps/local/netspout: app directory gone, 0 processes, indexed data kept; var/lib/netspout (config, engine.key, engine.json, launcher.lock) is left behind
results.limit: state directory and its per-install key are not removed on uninstall
